newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish up after support holds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish up after support holds.

text.p: Sept 9 - U.S. debt futures finished higher after December bond support levels held near midday and the market drifted up all afternoon. Futures traders tied late strength to commercial short-covering from players who had sold the opening. Interest also sparked after support at 106-22/32 held. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
